methodology:
United Plantations is a 120-year-old Malaysian plantation operator with 50,854 hectares (46,227 oil palm + 4,627 coconut) plus 4 mills in Malaysia + 1 in Indonesia + 2 specialty refineries (Unitata, Unifuji). FY25 record net profit MYR 830M.

UP famously runs net cash with conservative financial discipline. Per-acre FMV at the high end of Malaysian palm comp range due to operational excellence + downstream value.
